faq.q: What corrosion protection is needed for Titanium Helicopter Rotor Hub in aerospace environments?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V naturally forms a protective TiO₂ passive layer that requires no additional coating for corrosion resistance in standard aerospace environments. For main rotor hub exposed to hydraulic fluids (Skydrol), de-icing fluids, or marine atmosphere, the passive layer is sufficient. However, galvanic isolation from carbon fiber composites (via fiberglass ply or PTFE sleeve) is required to prevent hydrogen embrittlement.

Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for main rotor hub.
